scientific.integrity: All nonstandard premises are taken from the full initiating paper: the elliptic-cone resolution, Gorensteinness, virtual freeness, preservation of minimal log discrepancy, and exact canonical index at the origin. The added stratification follows from an explicit stabilizer calculation and étale-local properties; no finite experiment, classification assumption, or inaccessible computational certificate is used.
limitations: The result concerns the explicit Nakamura--Shibata family and does not assert a general semicontinuity theorem for canonical indices.
The minimal-log-discrepancy formula is for closed points; positive-dimensional centers are essential to the non-klt behavior.
The statement is restricted to m at least 2, where the distinguished canonical index is nontrivial.

title: The Nakamura--Shibata counterexamples have a singular line but only one non-Gorenstein point
